author: Mark Atwood
text:
Decision (Mark, 2026-05-13): Option (A). Generate new self-signed tier certs in pkix-path/tests/fixtures/policy-checks/, modeled after zlint's smime_leg1_*_eff1.pem fixture shapes (policy OID + DN attrs).

Sub-question answers (agent decided per Mark's delegation):

1. gen.py extension. Single fixture generator; no per-crate fragmentation.

2. Provenance docs: inline rustdoc on each test, plus a brief comment block in the gen.py extension citing the zlint fixture each was modeled after. No separate SOURCES.md — keeps provenance close to point of use.

3. Uniform across PKIX-jbvb.1, .2, .3. Same tier-cert shape, same approach for all three.

Closing; PKIX-jbvb.{1,2,3} unblock for autonomous work.
